Indian Coast Guard Rescues Fishermen and Cargo Vessel

The Indian Coast Guard conducted rescue operations for six fishermen whose boat sank off the Mangaluru coast due to rough seas. In a separate incident, the Coast Guard also saved a cargo vessel, MV SITTHAA, which was experiencing flooding off the Tamil Nadu coast. These operations highlight the Coast Guard's role in maritime safety.
